name: Ring of Evasion

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Evade
powers.text: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, spend 1 charge and your Reaction to succeed instead (used automatically).

summary: 3 charges: when you fail a Dexterity save, a Reaction turns it into a success.
text: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 of its charges to succeed on that saving throw instead.
